worldcombat.skill.metalburst.summary: Blasts the most recent damage it took out of its body at 1.5x; the debtor takes the full sum and other nearby foes take a share, while an empty ledger just clanks.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.use.0: Erupt after a hit to punish a close pack
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.use.1: Shave a whole melee down with the blast
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.use.2: Turn damage taken into area damage
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.description: Erupts the %1$s point refund recorded on the user; only damage taken within the last %2$s is kept on the ledger, physical or special alike.
Blast radius %1$s blocks, up to %2$s enemies; the debtor takes the full sum and every other enemy in the blast takes %3$s. The refund never exceeds %4$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.shrapnel.on: Shrapnel mode on: the blast is wider and nearby foes take a larger share, but the primary target's sum drops to 80%, prepare takes 2 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.shrapnel.of: Shrapnel mode off: a tighter blast that puts the whole stress on the primary target.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast radius grows to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.metalburst.growth.1: At level %1$s the blast radius grows to %2$s blocks and the refund cap rises to %3$s.
On: the blast is wider and nearby foes take a larger share, but the primary target's sum drops to 80%, prepare takes 2 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more. Off: a tighter blast that puts the whole stress on the primary target.
Only chase the debtor within this distance to detonate; a larger value pursues the debt further.
